title: Microsoft Teams: external phone call routing in GCC High and DoD
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap details, routing defaults, licence requirements and all six control paths and commands are supported. The checklist asks administrators to check voicemail availability without a corresponding control row; this is a minor completeness issue.

claims.where: title; front matter: products; What's changing
claims.claim: The roadmap change is Microsoft Teams external phone call routing.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams: External phone call routing (GCC High, DoD)

claims.claim: The roadmap describes redirecting all external phone calls to voicemail or unanswered settings.
claims.quote: External call routing will provide users the ability to redirect all external phone calls to either voicemail or their unanswered settings.

The roadmap description does not name the individual routing settings.
claims.quote: External call routing will provide users the ability to redirect all external phone calls to either voicemail or their unanswered settings.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Administrators can use policies to send external calls to voicemail, unanswered settings or normal routing to help prevent unwanted calls.
claims.quote: As an admin, you can create policies that help prevent your users from getting unwanted calls from external parties. You can control whether these external calls should always be sent to voicemail, sent to unanswered settings, or use normal call routing.

claims.claim: PSTN calls originate from the public telephone network.
claims.quote: This article describes how to route incoming calls that come from the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) or calls that are federated.

claims.claim: Federated calls originate outside the tenant and not from the PSTN, including Teams calls from another tenant.
claims.quote: Federated calls are calls that don't originate from the PSTN and that are outside your tenant. For example, a call from Teams or Skype for Business that is from another tenant would be considered federated.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents the routing policy settings as available in GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: These policy settings are also available for GCCH & DoD use.

claims.claim: The PSTN routing parameter supports RegularIncoming, Unanswered, Voicemail and UserOverride.
claims.quote: Valid options are: ... RegularIncoming: No changes are made to default inbound routing. ... Unanswered: The inbound PSTN call will be routed ... Voicemail: The inbound PSTN call will be routed ... UserOverride: Users can determine their PSTN call routing choice from call settings in the Teams app.

claims.claim: Federated routing supports RegularIncoming, Unanswered and Voicemail.
claims.quote: Valid options are: ... RegularIncoming: No changes are made to default inbound routing. ... Unanswered: The inbound federated call will be routed according to the called user's unanswered call settings ... Voicemail: The inbound federated call will be routed directly to the called user's voicemail

claims.claim: Let users decide is available only for PSTN routing and lets users choose in the Teams app's call settings.
claims.quote: Let users decide (PSTN calls only) Users can determine their PSTN call routing choice from call settings in the Teams app.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: PSTN Unanswered and Voicemail routing take precedence over forwarding, simultaneous delegate ringing and call groups.
claims.quote: If Use unanswered settings or Send to voicemail is used, either of these settings will have precedence over other call forwarding settings like call forwarding with simultaneous ringing to delegate, call groups, or call forwarding.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Federated Unanswered and Voicemail routing take precedence over forwarding, simultaneous delegate ringing and call groups.
claims.quote: If Unanswered or Send to voicemail is used, either of these settings will have precedence over other call forwarding settings like call forwarding with simultaneous ringing to delegate, call groups, or call forwarding.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: A call routed to voicemail is disconnected if the called user does not have voicemail enabled.
claims.quote: If the called user doesn't have voicemail enabled, the call will be disconnected.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A call routed to unanswered settings is disconnected if the called user has not enabled unanswered call settings.
claims.quote: If the called user has not enabled unanswered call settings the call will be disconnected.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Under Unanswered routing, the called user sees a missed call notification.
claims.quote: The called user will see a missed call notification.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; What's changing
claims.claim: Send to voicemail routes the call directly to voicemail without presenting it to the called user.
claims.quote: Send to voicemail The call is routed directly to voicemail and isn't shown to the user.

claims.claim: Callers' voicemail messages are deposited in the user's mailbox.
claims.quote: A voicemail in Exchange is an email message with an audio file attachment. Cloud Voicemail deposits these voicemail messages in a user's Exchange mailbox.

claims.claim: Unanswered routing uses the called user's per-user unanswered forwarding settings, rather than a destination set in the routing policy.
claims.quote: Use unanswered settings The call is routed according to the unanswered call forwarding settings set for that user.

claims.claim: A user's unanswered destination can be MyDelegates.
claims.quote: MyDelegates is used when forwarding an unanswered call to the user's delegates. This option is supported for users but isn't supported for resource accounts.

claims.claim: A user's unanswered destination can be Group.
claims.quote: Group is used when forwarding an unanswered call to the specified user's or resource account's call group.

claims.where: controls[0..1].scope; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Routing policy values govern the users within that calling policy.
claims.quote: For PSTN calls, you can also allow your users within the policy to decide.

claims.claim: Changing the Global calling policy changes routing for users in the Global default policy instance.
claims.quote: This script sets -InboundPstnCallRoutingTreatment to route inbound PSTN calls according to the unanswered call forwarding settings for users in the Global (default) Teams Calling Policy instance:

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationales: risk, impact
claims.claim: The new routing control is admin-opt-in: RegularIncoming leaves default inbound routing unchanged until an administrator selects a different treatment.
claims.quote: RegularIncoming: No changes are made to default inbound routing. This is the default setting.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model, licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Redirect external phone calls is included with Microsoft Teams Enterprise plus Teams Phone, not Teams Enterprise alone.
claims.quote: Redirect external phone calls | Send inbound calls from external callers to user's forwarding settings (for example, voicemail) while not impacting internal calls. | Image of a x for no | Image of a checkmark for yes

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Users needing their own telephone number to make and receive calls need licensing including Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Phone System.
claims.quote: All users who require their own telephone number to make and receive telephone calls must be assigned with licensing that includes the Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Phone System applications.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A legacy Microsoft 365 E5 licence includes Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Phone System.
claims.quote: A legacy Microsoft 365 E5 license - includes Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Phone System applications

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Teams Enterprise combined with Microsoft Teams Phone Standard is an example of qualifying Teams Phone licensing.
claims.quote: A Microsoft Teams Enterprise license combined with Microsoft Teams Phone Standard license

claims.claim: When Microsoft supplies PSTN access and phone numbers, a Microsoft Calling Plan licence is required in addition to Teams Phone licensing.
claims.quote: If you elect to use Microsoft to provide your PSTN access and phone numbers, in addition to Teams Phone licensing, the user also requires a Microsoft Calling Plan license.

claims.claim: The Routing inbound calls page itself names no licence, meter or separate charge for the routing settings.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams inbound call routing external PSTN federated GCC High DoD separate charge price licensing default policy. Opened Routing inbound calls, Teams Calling features and Teams Phone licensing; the routing article names no licence, meter or charge.

claims.claim: The routing article applies to Microsoft Calling Plans, Operator Connect, Teams Phone Mobile and Direct Routing.
claims.quote: This article applies to Microsoft Calling Plans, Operator Connect, Teams Phone Mobile, and Direct Routing.

claims.claim: The government service description says Phone System in GCC High and DoD is delivered via Direct Routing.
claims.quote: Phone System and Audio Conferencing for GCC High and DoD environments are being delivered via Direct Routing.

claims.claim: The documented per-user call forwarding and unanswered configuration is available only in Teams Only deployment mode.
claims.quote: This feature is only in Teams Only deployment mode.

claims.claim: The user's Voice tab requires an assigned Microsoft Teams Phone licence.
claims.quote: On the user details page, go to the Voice tab. If the Voice tab isn't visible, the user doesn't have a Microsoft Teams Phone license assigned.

claims.claim: The PSTN routing control is at Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Routing for PSTN calls.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Microsoft Teams admin center, select Voice > Calling policies. ... Choose the policy you would like to update or select Add to create a new policy. ... Select an option for Routing for PSTN calls.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -InboundPstnCallRoutingTreatment Unanswered sets Global-policy PSTN routing to unanswered settings.
claims.quote: Module: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module. ... Setting this parameter lets you control how inbound PSTN calls should be routed. ... Unanswered: The inbound PSTN call will be routed according to the called user's unanswered call settings

claims.claim: The federated routing control is at Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Routing for federated calls.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Microsoft Teams admin center, select Voice > Calling policies. ... Select the policy you would like to update or select Add to create a new policy. ... Choose an option for Routing for federated calls.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -InboundFederatedCallRoutingTreatment Voicemail sets Global-policy federated routing to voicemail.
claims.quote: Module: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module. ... Setting this parameter lets you control how inbound federated calls should be routed. ... Voicemail: The inbound federated call will be routed directly to the called user's voicemail

claims.claim: The user's unanswered destination is at Teams admin center > Users > Manage users > user > Voice > Call answering rules > If unanswered.
claims.quote: Go to Users > Manage users and select a licensed user. ... On the user details page, go to the Voice tab. ... under Call answering rules ... To configure unanswered settings, select the appropriate setting in the If unanswered drop-down.

claims.claim: Set-CsUserCallingSettings -Identity user6@contoso.com -IsUnansweredEnabled $true -UnansweredTargetType Voicemail -UnansweredDelay 00:00:20 enables that user's unanswered forwarding to voicemail with a valid delay.
claims.quote: Set-CsUserCallingSettings -Identity user6@contoso.com -IsUnansweredEnabled $true -UnansweredTargetType Voicemail -UnansweredDelay 00:00:20

claims.claim: Unmodified user call answering rules forward unanswered calls to voicemail after 30 seconds.
claims.quote: If a user or tenant admin doesn't modify their call answering rules, unanswered calls are forwarded to voicemail after 30 seconds by default.

claims.claim: The displayed unmodified unanswered target in Teams admin center or Teams PowerShell is none.
claims.quote: The settings displayed for the user in Teams admin center or Teams PowerShell show the unanswered target as none and a delay of 20 seconds.

claims.claim: The displayed unmodified unanswered delay in Teams admin center or Teams PowerShell is 20 seconds.
claims.quote: The settings displayed for the user in Teams admin center or Teams PowerShell show the unanswered target as none and a delay of 20 seconds.

claims.claim: The inbound routing page does not describe these settings as a security control for a specific attack.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams inbound external call routing InboundPstnCallRoutingTreatment security attack agent automatic approval calling policy assigned users. Read Routing inbound calls and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy; routing is described as preventing unwanted external calls, not a named attack.

claims.claim: No agent or additional automated action beyond call routing is described for these policy settings.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams inbound external call routing InboundPstnCallRoutingTreatment security attack agent automatic approval calling policy assigned users. Opened Routing inbound calls and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy; the treatment descriptions name call routing, not an agent or another action.

claims.claim: A separate price for these routing settings, including a GCC High or DoD-specific charge, is not published in the relevant documentation found.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams inbound call routing external PSTN federated GCC High DoD separate charge price licensing default policy; "external call routing" "price" "GCC" Teams. Read Routing inbound calls, Teams Calling features, Teams Phone licensing, Office 365 GCC High and DoD; no routing-specific price.

claims.claim: The per-user unanswered setting selects a destination, not the policy treatment that specifically diverts external calls.
claims.quote: The unanswered call target type. For a user, supported values are Voicemail, SingleTarget, MyDelegates, and Group.

claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to check whether voicemail is enabled, but the controls table has no row for voicemail availability.
claims.quote: Confirm that each affected user has voicemail enabled and unanswered call settings configured ... Controls: inbound PSTN routing; inbound federated routing; user's unanswered destination.
claims.fix: Remove 'voicemail enabled and' from the Before rollout checklist bullet, leaving 'Confirm that each affected user has unanswered call settings configured, because a call is disconnected where the chosen destination is not available.' Keep the supported voicemail prerequisite in the body; do not add a control row.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Why it matters
claims.claim: Once an administrator chooses Unanswered or Voicemail, calls of that external type are diverted for policy users without requiring approval for each call.
claims.quote: You can control whether these external calls should always be sent to voicemail, sent to unanswered settings, or use normal call routing.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Unanswered routing diverts the external call without presenting it to the called user.
claims.quote: Unanswered: The inbound PSTN call will be routed according to the called user's unanswered call settings and the call will not be presented to the called user.
